notes.id: Besaran uang pangkal tidak dicantumkan. Diskon uang pangkal 30% untuk pendaftaran s.d. Desember 2026 dan 20% s.d. Maret 2027; diskon khusus 10% (keluarga pengurus/staf) dan 7% (jamaah pengajian Nurul Qolby). Inden cukup uang pendaftaran + 20% uang pangkal; uang pangkal bisa diangsur. Katering dan antar-jemput opsional.
notes.en: The entry fee amount is not published. 30% off the entry fee for registration by December 2026, 20% by March 2027; special 10% (foundation/staff families) and 7% (Nurul Qolby congregation) discounts. Reserve a place with the registration fee + 20% of the entry fee; the entry fee can be paid in instalments. Catering and transport optional.
